name: Tung Wah Hospital
scope: The six-storey 1934 Main Block of Tung Wah Hospital, also known as the Li Shiu Chung Memorial Building, in May 2025. Its two exterior entrance porches, assembly-hall entrance and associated facade are in scope. The neighboring hospital towers are recorded for context.

references.filename: HK SW 上環 Sheung Wan 普仁街 Po Yan Street 東華醫院 Tung Wah Hospital Group May 2025 R12S 01.jpg

originalReview.notes: The 2025 view shows the columned outside entrance to the assembly hall, two tall pale stone columns, broad steps, shallow landing, and dark entrance door.

review.method: Exact Qualla original and named native public-domain release
review.notes: The exact Qualla original matches the Commons upload byte for byte. Its named uploader and photographer, Suwm HorC POONZ, applied a CC0 own-work dedication. The 2008 campus photo is not relied on for the precise Main Block elevations.
